mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM dashboard WHERE code = #{code}

SELECT organization.tenant_id, organization.path AS organization_path, COALESCE(organization.zone_id, tenant.default_zone_id) AS effective_zone_id FROM organization JOIN tenant ON tenant.id = organization.tenant_id WHERE organization.id = #{organizationId} AND organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND tenant.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dashboard(id, tenant_id, organization_id, owner_account_id, code, display_name, description, default_zone_id, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{dashboard.id}, #{dashboard.tenantId}, #{dashboard.organizationId}, #{dashboard.ownerAccountId}, #{dashboard.code}, #{dashboard.displayName}, #{dashboard.description}, #{dashboard.defaultZoneId}, #{dashboard.status}, #{dashboard.version}, #{dashboard.createdAt}, #{dashboard.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT dashboard.id, dashboard.tenant_id, dashboard.organization_id, dashboard.owner_account_id, dashboard.code, dashboard.display_name, dashboard.description, dashboard.default_zone_id, dashboard.status, dashboard.version, dashboard.created_at, dashboard.updated_at, organization.path AS organization_path FROM dashboard JOIN organization ON organization.id = dashboard.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = dashboard.tenant_id WHERE dashboard.id = #{dashboardId}

SELECT dashboard.id, dashboard.tenant_id, dashboard.organization_id, dashboard.owner_account_id, dashboard.code, dashboard.display_name, dashboard.description, dashboard.default_zone_id, dashboard.status, dashboard.version, dashboard.created_at, dashboard.updated_at, organization.path AS organization_path FROM dashboard JOIN organization ON organization.id = dashboard.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = dashboard.tenant_id WHERE (organization.path = #{organizationPath} OR organization.path LIKE CONCAT(#{organizationPath}, '/%')) AND (#{includeArchived} OR dashboard.status = 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY dashboard.updated_at DESC, dashboard.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, meter_id, title, visualization, value_field, aggregation, bucket_seconds, layout::text AS layout_json, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM dashboard_widget WHERE dashboard_id = #{dashboardId} ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dashboard_widget(id, tenant_id, dashboard_id, meter_id, title, visualization, value_field, aggregation, bucket_seconds, layout, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{widget.id}, #{widget.tenantId}, #{widget.dashboardId}, #{widget.meterId}, #{widget.title}, #{widget.visualization}, #{widget.valueField}, #{widget.aggregation}, #{widget.bucketSeconds}, CAST(#{widget.layoutJson} AS jsonb), #{widget.sortOrder}, #{widget.createdAt}, #{widget.updatedAt})
